_comment: Shared golden vectors for the Notifications domain (web useNotifications). Consumed by both the KMP core (NotificationsGoldenTest) and the Windows C# port so the client-side derivations cannot drift (ADR-004). Source-of-truth web hook: web/src/api/hooks/useNotifications.ts.

notificationFilterParams._comment: Web serializeNotificationFilters: ordered snake_case map; multi-value CSV; bool only when non-null; string only when non-blank; number always when present. Order: severity, vehicle_id, rule_id, from, to, read, archived, q, group_key, limit, offset.

notificationGroupsParams._comment: Web useNotificationGroups: grouped=true FIRST, then the filters with group_key removed (mutual-exclusion contract).

bulkMarkReadBody._comment: Web useBulkMarkRead JSON.stringify(vars): exactly one of ids | all | group_key.

acknowledgeBody._comment: Web useAcknowledgeAlert: { note } only when the trimmed note is non-empty (verbatim trimmed value sent); otherwise {}.
